reason: Calm resolve or obliviousness to danger does not establish absence of fear; the historical unafraid gloss conflates fearlessness with composure and ignorance of danger.
The color-light gloss attributes lightness to a small amount of coloring agent, an unsupported restriction on color brightness that excludes illumination and other causes.
The color-dark gloss says having a dark hue, repeating the headword without independently explaining the shade.
The close gloss repeats close in relevance or relationship, providing a context rather than an independent definition.

The unconscious gloss asserts loss of the capacity for sensory perception and likens it to sleep or death, an unsuitable biological overstatement; sensory processing can persist in nonconscious states. See https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/30364373/.
The continual gloss first asserts occurrence without interruption, then describes regular or frequent recurrence; it conflates continuous and recurrent occurrence.
The mature gloss only says characteristic of maturity, substituting a derivative without explaining the intended development or behavior.
The immature gloss only says characteristic of a lack of maturity, without independently explaining the intended development or behavior.
The natural gloss only repeats in accordance with nature and relating to nature, without explaining the intended category or property.
The unnatural gloss only restates contrary to nature or not determined by nature, without explaining what this poorly specified nature criterion denotes.
The open gloss only specifies use of mouth or eyes; it provides usage context but no definition of the property.
The closed gloss only specifies use especially of mouth or eyes; it provides usage context but no definition of the property.
The privileged gloss only says blessed with privileges, restating the derivative without explaining rights or advantages.
The same gloss allows merely comparable qualities, whereas comparability does not establish sameness; it obscures the distinction from different.
The satisfactory gloss only says giving satisfaction, substituting a nominal derivative without explaining adequacy or fulfillment of expectations.
The unsatisfactory gloss only says not giving satisfaction, without independently explaining inadequacy or failure to meet expectations.
The liquid gloss repeats existing as or having characteristics of a liquid; tending to flow does not independently distinguish this physical state from gases.
The sufficient gloss requires absence of abundance; an abundant quantity can also fulfill a requirement, so this restriction confuses sufficiency with bare adequacy.
Relative is defined by estimation through comparison, while absolute is defined by perfection, completeness, or purity; the selected senses contrast different properties.
Individual describes a single thing or person, while common describes communal participation or public ownership; singularity and communal participation are different dimensions that can coexist.
Planar and linear describe dimensional categories rather than opposing properties; a line can be embedded in a plane, and the displayed definitions do not establish an antonymic opposition.
Independent concerns freedom from external control, while dependent concerns requiring support or supply; support dependence can coexist with independence of control.
The subordinate sense concerns lower rank or importance, while dominant concerns exercising influence or control; someone of lower rank can still exercise dominant influence.
The nonspecific sense concerns an unidentified causal agent or microscope staining, while specific is a general particularity or uniqueness sense; the displayed scopes do not match.

Recorded concerns permanent registration, while live concerns contemporaneous performance; a live performance can simultaneously be recorded, and permanent records need not concern performances at all.
Past and present are adjacent alternatives in a three-part time classification; present is explicitly intermediate between past and future rather than the opposite endpoint of past.
Future and present are adjacent alternatives in a three-part time classification; present is explicitly intermediate between past and future rather than the opposite endpoint of future.

Irresponsible concerns lack of care for consequences, whereas responsible also includes being held accountable; a careless person may still be held accountable, so these combined senses do not give a reliable opposition.
Writing and speech are alternative communication media, rather than opposite meanings; the same material can be both written down and spoken.
